content.title: WWE News! Major Title Change! Injury Forces WWE Star Out of WrestleMania Week! Ripley's Health Issue
content.text: WWE News! Major Title Change! Injury Forces WWE Star Out of WrestleMania Week! Ripley's Health Issue WWE News and WWE Rumors for today include a shocking title change, a WWE star ruled out of WrestleMania 42 week due to injury, and a concerning update on Rhea Ripley’s health. In this video, we break down the latest WWE News, WWE Rumors, and Wrestling News as a major title change has taken place in AEW. Darby Allin defeated MJF in a shocking main event to become the new AEW Champion, closing Dynamite with a huge moment. Despite the match being short, the emotional build and crowd reaction made it one of the most talked-about title changes in recent weeks. We also cover a serious injury update involving Santos Escobar. The WWE star, who was already sidelined following triceps surgery, has now revealed an additional ulnar nerve issue that requires another procedure. This setback officially rules him out of WrestleMania 42 week and raises concerns about his long-term recovery timeline. Meanwhile, Rhea Ripley has opened up about a personal health issue, revealing she is currently dealing with an eating disorder. Her honest response shifts the conversation away from speculation about her appearance and highlights the real challenges she is facing behind the scenes during WrestleMania season. With WrestleMania 42 approaching, major title changes, injuries, and personal struggles are shaping the wrestling world in a big way. Do you think Darby Allin winning the title was the right move, and should WWE adjust plans due to injuries this close to WrestleMania? Stay tuned for more WWE News, WWE Rumors, and Wrestling News.
